items.title: Trammell Crow Pays $67.5M for Chelsea Site Near High Line
items.summary: Trammell Crow paid $67.5 million off-market for a Chelsea development site near the High Line that can hold about 160,000 square feet.

items.title: A $6.2 Billion Hedge Fund Dumps These 2 Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysValueAct Capital’s latest 13F shows it sold all of its Roblox and CBRE shares in the third quarter. Roblox has guided fourth-quarter bookings down 10% to 15%, and analysts’ average target is down about two-thirds in a year.

items.title: Stonehenge Lands $233M Refi on Midtown West’s Ritz Plaza
items.summary: Natixis led a $233.3 million floating-rate refinancing for Stonehenge's renovated 479-unit Ritz Plaza apartment building in Midtown West.

items.title: CBRE Group Stock: Analyst Estimates & Ratings
items.summary: While CBRE Group has underperformed relative to the broader market over the past year, Wall Street analysts remain bullish about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: CBRE Group (CBRE) Sees Deal Volume Jump As Undervalued Narrative Holds
items.summary: CBRE Group (CBRE) is in focus after reporting that U.S. commercial real estate investment volume reached US$257.8b in Q3 2026, almost double a year earlier and helped by two large entity-level deals. Despite the strong Q3 investment data, CBRE Group’s share price tells a more mixed story. The stock is trading at US$132.54, with the 30-day share price return up 2.85% but the year-to-date move down 17.26%, while the 3-year total shareholder return of 69.62% points to much stronger longer term...

items.title: CBRE: Q3 Investment Volume Jumps 98% to $257.8B
items.summary: Two $104 billion entity-level deals nearly doubled Q3 CRE investment volume to $257.8 billion, while underlying market activity grew 18%.

items.title: Brookfield Gears Up to Report Q3 Earnings: What's in the Cards?
items.summary: BN's Q3 earnings are expected to rise 14.3% year over year, with fundraising, AI infrastructure investments and higher financing costs in focus.

items.title: Rate Whiplash Has CRE's Biggest Brokerages Bracing For A Flat Q4
items.summary: Seesawing 10-year Treasury yields have flattened brokerages’ Q4 capital markets outlooks and injected fresh volatility into financing.
